comment: Example of a machine file. Copy it to ~/.config/herdr-skill/resources.json and change it. An entry with the same id replaces the entry of the catalog. "remove": true takes an entry out. Both entries below are optional examples; the catalog does not ship them. For Claude Code, spawn.py gives each entry of the kind mcp that has a url location to the new session as an MCP server and allows its tools. The server name is the mcp_server value, or the id of the entry. The launch object is optional; it sets the files that spawn.py gives to a harness.

hound.title: Hound MCP
hound.use_when: First choice when it is available. Good for search and for pages that load without a real browser.
hound.load: Tools `hound_mcp_smart_search` and `hound_mcp_smart_fetch`, direct or through the `mcp` tool.

desktop-browser.title: Example desktop browser
desktop-browser.use_when: When the task asks for it, when a page needs a real browser, or when the first choice gives no usable content.
desktop-browser.load: Read the file at the location and follow it, with its pacing rules.
